ex.en: Smoking is prohibited on the train.
ex.zh: 在火車上禁止吸菸。

ex.en: Smoking is prohibited in this room.
ex.zh: 這個房間禁止吸菸。

ex.en: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
ex.zh: 這個國家嚴禁進口稀有野生動物。

ex.en: Camera quality is a top priority for me.
ex.zh: 相機畫質是我最優先考慮的。

ex.en: Safety is our top priority.
ex.zh: 安全是我們的首要考量。

ex.en: Mennad's presentation was perfect.
ex.zh: 門納德的簡報非常完美。

ex.en: I'll keep the tips you shared for improving my presentation skills.
ex.zh: 你分享的提升簡報技巧的建議，我會記下來。

ex.en: The food was delicious, and the presentation was beautiful.
ex.zh: 菜很好吃，擺盤也很漂亮。

ex.en: Good presentation can make a simple product look special.
ex.zh: 好的呈現方式能讓簡單的產品看起來很特別。

ex.en: Sales projections for next year look promising.
ex.zh: 明年的銷售預測看起來很樂觀。

ex.en: Our projections were too optimistic.
ex.zh: 我們的預估太樂觀了。

ex.en: The projection on the screen was blurry.
ex.zh: 螢幕上的投影很模糊。

ex.en: The museum uses 3D projection to tell the story.
ex.zh: 博物館用 3D 投影來說故事。

ex.en: Our company has many projects to do.
ex.zh: 我們公司有很多專案要做。

ex.en: We must consider the financial aspects of this project.
ex.zh: 我們必須考慮這個專案的財務面。

ex.en: Their common aim was to make the project successful.
ex.zh: 他們共同的目標是讓這個專案成功。

ex.en: She studied the bat's anatomy for her biology project.
ex.zh: 她為了生物專題研究蝙蝠的身體構造。

ex.en: We're doing a group project on climate change.
ex.zh: 我們正在做一個關於氣候變遷的小組專題。

ex.en: Sales are projected to grow by 5% next year.
ex.zh: 預計明年銷售額會成長 5%。

ex.en: The city's population is projected to double.
ex.zh: 預估這座城市的人口將倍增。

ex.en: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
ex.zh: 這艘船頂著強風緩慢前進。

ex.en: We're making good progress on the project.
ex.zh: 我們的專案進展得很順利。

ex.en: This essay is progressing a little bit slowly.
ex.zh: 這篇論文寫得有點慢。

ex.en: She is progressing in Chinese.
ex.zh: 她中文有進步。

ex.en: The economy progressed slowly.
ex.zh: 經濟發展得很緩慢。

prioritize.zh: 排定優先順序；優先處理

ex.en: You need to prioritize your tasks.
ex.zh: 你需要排定工作的優先順序。

ex.en: The hospital prioritizes the most serious cases.
ex.zh: 醫院會優先處理最嚴重的病例。

ex.en: She works in the procurement department.
ex.zh: 她在採購部工作。

ex.en: The procurement process takes about two weeks.
ex.zh: 採購流程大約需要兩週。

ex.en: A 30% prepayment is required before production starts.
ex.zh: 開始生產前需要支付 30% 的預付款。

ex.en: We offer a discount for full prepayment.
ex.zh: 全額預付可享折扣。

ex.en: Tom was hoping the committee would adopt his proposal.
ex.zh: 湯姆希望委員會採納他的提案。

ex.en: I am in favor of your proposal.
ex.zh: 我贊成你的提案。

ex.en: Why did they turn down your proposal?
ex.zh: 他們為什麼否決了你的提案？

ex.en: She said yes to his marriage proposal.
ex.zh: 她答應了他的求婚。

ex.en: He made his proposal on the beach.
ex.zh: 他在海灘上求婚。

ex.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
ex.zh: 請把印表機裡用完的墨水匣換掉。

ex.en: I bought this printer yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天買了這個印表機。

ex.en: The printer stopped in the middle, so I only have part of his CV.
ex.zh: 印表機印到一半就停了，所以我只拿到他履歷的一部分。

ex.en: What's wrong with this projector? It won't display anything.
ex.zh: 這台投影機怎麼了？什麼都投不出來。

ex.en: Can you turn on the projector for the presentation?
ex.zh: 可以幫忙打開投影機準備簡報嗎？

ex.en: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
ex.zh: 他提議對教育系統進行改革。

ex.en: He's proposing a suggestion for altering the research method.
ex.zh: 他提議修改研究方法。

ex.en: I'm going to propose to her.
ex.zh: 我打算向她求婚。

ex.en: Johnny proposed to Alice and she accepted.
ex.zh: 約翰向愛麗絲求婚，而且她接受了。

ex.en: Would you please replace the broken one promptly?
ex.zh: 可以請你儘快把壞掉的那個換掉嗎？

ex.en: Please reply promptly so we can confirm your booking.
ex.zh: 請儘快回覆，以便我們確認您的預訂。

ex.en: She is proficient in French.
ex.zh: 她精通法語。

ex.en: He is proficient in Farsi.
ex.zh: 他精通波斯語。

ex.en: He got a promotion.
ex.zh: 他升職了。

ex.en: My colleague and I do the same job, but she was promised a promotion very soon.
ex.zh: 我和同事做一樣的工作，但公司答應她很快就會升職。

ex.en: Recently T Mall has had a sales promotion on cell phones.
ex.zh: 最近天貓有手機促銷活動。

ex.en: The store is running a buy-one-get-one-free promotion.
ex.zh: 這家店正在做買一送一的促銷。

ex.en: New employees are on probation for three months.
ex.zh: 新進員工有三個月的試用期。

ex.en: She passed her probation and became a full-time staff member.
ex.zh: 她通過試用期，成為正式員工。

ex.en: Tom is on probation.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在緩刑中。

ex.en: He was sentenced to two years' probation.
ex.zh: 他被判緩刑兩年。
